correctness.rationale: Uniform ordinal-sum points are obtained by uniformly permuting consecutive order-statistic rank blocks, yielding volume ∏m_i!/n!. Covariances of uniform order statistics are c_rs=min(r,s)(n+1-max(r,s))/((n+1)^2(n+2)). Within-layer contrast variance λ_i=(m_i+1)(m_i+2)/[12(n+1)(n+2)]; group-average covariance has normalized k×k block B. Orthogonal block determinant then gives exact detΣ. For fixed k and positive α, n c_rs converges to Brownian-bridge covariance; Riemann sums give B→C positive definite. Uniform Taylor for λ_i and Stirling for volume cancel O(n) terms, leaving −(k−1)log n+γ_k(α). Independently enumerated rank permutations and exact Fractions for (2,2),(1,2,1),(2,1,2) verify determinant; finite enumeration is not asymptotic proof.

Exact checks in three small sizes are corroboration, not proof of all-dimensional asymptotic.

It is not a routine consequence of merely knowing combinatorial volume or a lattice free-sum structure.
